title: Semi-private SMALL group Historic Walking Tours w/certified guide
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Talk a walking tour of the most Historic city, Charleston, Southern Carolina in America with a certified and licensed guide. Charleston is where one of the first decisive victories of the American Revolution was fought, as well as the first shots of the Civil War.

Take a two hour stroll down picturesque streets and hidden alleys, taking in the beauty of homes, some of which were constructed before the Revolutionary War.
